sentences.japanese: 恐怖で彼の足が震えていた。
sentences.english: His legs were trembling from fear.

sentences.japanese: 臆病なその男は恐怖に震えた。
sentences.english: The timid man trembled with fear.

sentences.japanese: 映画の最中に彼は震え始めた。
sentences.english: He began to tremble during the movie.

sentences.japanese: われわれは皆ひどい寒さに震えていた。
sentences.english: We were all shaking from the bitter cold.
